task: GO-ON MASTER BUG FIX — NOTIFICATION TIMESTAMPS MUST USE IST CORRECTLY & NOTIFICATION ACTIONS ENHANCEMENT

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Database stores UTC datetimes without timezone offset. Pydantic v2 serialized these naive datetimes into ISO strings lacking 'Z' or timezone designator, leaving parsing open to client local timezone assumptions.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Implemented serialize_utc_iso helper ensuring naive and aware datetimes are converted to UTC and formatted with explicit 'Z' suffix. Applied @field_serializer(..., when_used='always') across NotificationLogOut, ScheduledNotificationOut, DeviceTokenOut, and AdminCustomNotificationResponse.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Dart DateTime.tryParse() without a 'Z' or offset designator defaults to local system time. An instant created at 07:55 UTC was interpreted as 07:55 IST instead of 13:25 IST, generating an immediate 5h 30m apparent lag ('5h ago').
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Created TimezoneUtils.parseUtc() which defensively normalizes incoming strings missing 'Z' by appending 'Z', guaranteeing isUtc=true. Relative-time calculations now compute delta in UTC reference frame, invariant to device local time.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Notification relative timestamps remained static while the screen stayed open, becoming stale over time.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Added Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 30), ...) in FacultyNotificationHistoryScreen and StudentNotificationScreen to dynamically refresh relative times. Safely cancelled in dispose().

audit_findings_and_resolutions.component: Notification Card Action Bar ('Tap to view')
audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Notification cards displayed generic 'Open View' action button without clear user affordance.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Updated button label to 'Tap to view' with arrow forward icon. Interacting with the action button invokes _showNotificationDetails and marks the notification as read via backend POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.component: Notification Details Bottom Sheet ('Delete' Action Button)
audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Bottom sheet modal featured duplicate navigation button instead of direct management action.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Replaced primary modal button with dedicated 'Delete' button styled with error/red background. Interacting calls backend DELETE /api/v1/notifications/{id} for soft deletion. Pinned notifications strictly reject deletion with 'Pinned notifications cannot be deleted. Unpin first.'. Linked destination navigation preserved as secondary preview row.
